name: Captain Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Captain Ventures (captain.vc; captain.ventures 308-redirects there; legal entity Captain Ventures Management, LLC per the site footer and schema.org data). It is a generalist seed-stage solo-GP firm with offices in Salt Lake City and San Francisco. Tyler Hogge, formerly a Partner at Pelion Venture Partners and SVP Product at Divvy, founded it. Day 1 was 2026-06-18 (founder's launch post on tylerhogge.com) and Fund 1 (~$33M) went live 2026-09-25 (firm's own log). The public LinkedIn company page (linkedin.com/company/captain-ventures) gives captain.vc as its website, says founded 2026, 1 employee. An SEC full-text search shows a Form D for Captain Ventures Fund I LP (CIK 0002157530, Delaware, filed 2026-10-05). captain.vc is a client-rendered single-page app: the text of each route was read from the site's JavaScript bundle, which every route serves. Ruled out: Captain (a San Francisco startup that raised $104M in 2022), Captain Experiences (Austin startup), Captain Fresh and Captain T Cell (startups), Capstar Ventures (a different fund), other SLC firms (Salt Coast Ventures, Salt VC) and Pelion Venture Partners itself: Pelion deals that Hogge led (Jump, Remi, Kapital, Redo, Honey Health, Agree, Vector, Valinor the multiomics company) and his Kindling Capital angel deals are not Captain Ventures investments.

thesis_text.value: Solo-GP generalist seed fund whose one criterion is deep conviction in the founder (the 'captain'), ideally before the market agrees. A deliberately small (~$30M target) fund lets it join any round alongside lead investors instead of competing for the lead, and it aims to be founders' most useful investor per dollar, helping with customers and the next raise.
thesis_text.snippet: So I realized $30m was the right target. I don't need the fees. I want to maximize returns.

open_items: No portfolio rounds recorded (0 of the 8 required). captain.vc's portfolio section says 'Coming Soon', and five web searches found no round announcement naming Captain Ventures as an investor. The firm launched on 2026-06-18 and Fund 1 went live on 2026-09-25, so it may not have announced any deals yet. Re-check in a later batch.

Investments listed on captain.vc/i, tylerhogge.com/investments and in directories are Tyler Hogge's earlier deals: Pelion leads (Jump, Remi, Kapital, Redo, Honey Health, Agree, Primer, Torus, Vector, Valinor the multiomics company) and angel deals through Kindling Capital (Flexport, Wander, Nursa, Neighbor and others). None were recorded as Captain Ventures rounds.

F4 lists Captain Ventures among the backers of Valinor (valinor.ai, a defense/government-tech company that raised a $25M seed led by Castle Island Ventures, March 2026). F4 mixes up several companies named Valinor and links to no round page naming Captain, so this was not recorded. The round predates the firm's 2026-06-18 launch.
No application form or apply URL. The site gives only a founder email address (not recorded); cold inbound is based on the Day 1 post's invitation to meet founders.
Check-size range not stated by the firm: only an average of about $750k across 25-30 planned investments. check_min_usd and check_max_usd are left out.
Stages: the firm calls itself seed-stage and says it seeks 'the first two rounds a company raises, but sometimes later too'. Pre-seed is likely but not stated, so only seed is recorded.
No stated sectors: the firm calls itself 'generalist', so stated_sectors is left out. Directory sector tags (Defense, SaaS, B2B on Private Equity List) aren't the firm's own words.

Nothing found on requiring a US entity or on investing in Indian founders. F4 says the firm is US-focused and excludes non-US companies as a primary focus, but Fund Momentum and Private Equity List report no geographic restriction; neither claim comes from the firm.
portfolio_count_reported not available: the firm reports no count, only a plan of 25-30 investments from Fund 1.

SEC EDGAR: the full-text search API (efts.sec.gov) returned the Form D index entry, but www.sec.gov refused the declared User-Agent for the filing document, so offering amounts come only from the AUM13F mirror.

Team: the firm is solo-GP (Tyler Hogge only, per the founder's Day 1 post: 'For now, it will just be me'). 'Founder & General Partner' appears only on directory pages; the firm's own pages say 'founder'.

A search summary mentioned a New York-based 'Captain Ventures' with a 2024 Fund I and $100K-$500K checks on venturecapitalarchive.com. The page returned 403, so this is unverified and could be a different firm or bad directory data.
The X/Twitter account @captain_vc_ and the founder's X posts were not read (feed scraping is not allowed).
